description: Create a public payment invoice from an existing paylink or Checkout Session for checkout integration, testing, or customer flow setup.

checkoutSessionId.description: Checkout Session public ID. The session supplies trusted amount, currency, and optional customer email.

clientReferenceId.description: Optional merchant reference for the customer or order; returned as customer.clientReferenceId in webhook payloads.

customerEmail.description: Customer email, required unless already present in the referenced Checkout Session. Do not invent an email.

language.description: Optional checkout language code supported by Yolfi.

metadata.description: Safe non-secret metadata for the target app payment flow.

network.description: Choose a network enabled in the organization or paylink supported-token catalog. Litecoin uses LTC.

paylinkId.description: Existing paylink ID, required unless checkoutSessionId supplies the checkout context.

subscriptionId.description: Optional existing subscription ID to associate the payment with.

symbol.description: Payment token symbol supported on the selected network, for example USDC on ARB or LTC on LTC.

name: yolfi_payments_create
title: Create Yolfi Public Payment
